answer: One concrete mechanism for an AI-agent economy to resist sybil attacks requires every agent to post a unique compute-proof into a time-locked vault before earning influence. The proof must be derived from a fresh seed and non-reusable across identities. An attacker pays the full generation cost for each fake account; at the zenith of an attack the marginal cost rises because each new alias needs an independent signal of work that cannot be pooled or recycled, making large-scale farming prohibitively expensive.
